answer: Sybil defense employs zero-knowledge attestations rooted in SGX enclaves: each identity registers through the Ember circuit, committing hardware-bound state to the Tundra accumulator while isolating execution within an ephemeral Island enclave. Forging an identity requires an adversary to compromise distinct physical enclave fuses, scaling attack costs through an O(N²) quadratic bonding curve and irreversible collateral slashing upon duplicate state derivation.
